name: flow-chapter-pipeline
description: Execute a Flow chapter using micro-sliced Context Packs, zero-token checklist synchronization, dynamic (model, effort) routing, and consolidated closeout review.

chapter_id.description: Optional chapter directory slug to pin execution.

tasks.description: Optional ordered task worksheet relative paths.

single_chapter.description: Pin execution to chapter_id instead of filling idle slots across all ready chapters.

all_ready_chapters.description: Allow work-conserving execution across all ready unblocked chapters.

max_workers.description: Maximum concurrent execution worker slots (default 4; clamped 1..12).

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent review seats or workers (default 4).

allow_uncommitted.description: Allow uncommitted deferred-commit receipts in post-execution OKF validation.

base_commit.description: Base Git commit SHA prior to execution.

execution_mode.description: Execute via work-conserving slot scheduler (default), warm batch, or per-task.

harness.description: Active harness identifier for dynamic routing.

executor_agent.description: Optional custom agent profile for execution.

reviewer_agent.description: Optional custom agent profile for review.
